# v1 synthetic observations

All four JSON files in `observations/` are hand-authored **synthetic/mock**
examples for the v1 model and offline tests. They are not Containerlab output,
live evidence, model traces, or historical acceptance results. Their values are
illustrative. `expected.json` contains scenario labels separately from the
observation documents; a future diagnostic runner must not pass that file to an
Agent. No v0.5/v0.7 record was changed or used to claim these outcomes.
